name: Camping am See International
beschreibung: The Campingplatz Camping am See International offers spacious pitches for caravans, motorhomes and tents. The sanitary facilities are modern and barrier-free. A dedicated swimming lake is located directly on site, and a playground is available for younger guests. The scenic surroundings are well suited for hiking tours and cycling excursions, while a convenient on-site shop provides campers with essential provisions.
